en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing an elevated panoramic view of a town surrounded by hills and cultivated fields. Dense blocks of stone buildings with tiled roofs fill the foreground and middle ground, while the rural landscape stretches into the distance. Printed caption text appears at the bottom margin, along with a small reference number and publisher name, characteristic of early 20th‑century postcards.
